ValidationRule.description: This validation rule makes the Risk and Compliance Category field mandatory for Get Help RTs.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false), !ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Complete"), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Status__c, "Evaluation Completed"), OR( (RecordType.DeveloperName = "Get_Help"), (RecordType.DeveloperName = "Get_Help_Appointment") ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Risk_and_Compliance_Category__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please ensure Risk and Compliance Category is populated.
